invariants.rationale: metadataWriteConfig is used unconditionally in this method, so it must not be null at method exit.
this.metrics is always set by this method to a non-null Option instance (either Option.of(...) or Option.empty()).
If metrics are on, this.metrics present, else not; reflects main branch structure.
If metrics is on, metrics Option wraps a HoodieMetadataMetrics created using metadataWriteConfig.getMetricsConfig().
If metrics are on, metrics Option wraps a HoodieMetadataMetrics created using dataMetaClient.getStorage().
